items.t: Ignition switch can shut off engine and disable airbags (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Key can be removed when ignition is not off (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Electric power steering can suddenly cut out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Power steering shuts off on non-recall years
items.job: Replace electric power steering motor / column assembly
items.note: CarComplaints shows an average of about $500 owner-paid; a new column costs more.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips, shifts harshly or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints average is about $3,000. Solenoid or module repairs cost far less.

items.t: Front end clunks over bumps
items.job: Replace front sway bar links and bushings
items.note: CarComplaints average is about $900 when struts are also replaced.

items.t: Worn wheel bearing hums or growls
items.job: Replace front wheel bearing hub assembly (one side)

items.t: Worn struts give a bouncy ride
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $667 to $1,200 for strut work.

items.t: Variable valve timing solenoid fault
items.note: Cam phaser replacement costs much more.

items.t: Fuel line leak
Inside door handle breaks off
items.note: If only a full door panel is used, cost rises sharply.

items.t: Thermostat sticks, causing poor heat or overheating
Blower fan works on only some speeds or not at all
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor (or blower motor)

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor or catalytic converter
items.note: A catalytic converter costs several hundred dollars more.

items.t: Windshield wipers stop or move erratically
Rear drum brake wheel cylinder leaks
items.job: Replace rear wheel cylinders and brake shoes

items.t: Headlight bulbs burn out often
Car may not be in Park when shifter shows Park (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Dash storage bin door may not stay shut (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.

items.t: Aftermarket leather seat covers can confuse the airbag sensor (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Ask the dealer to confirm it was done.
